content: General Questions What type of healthcare professional are you? Please select one of the following: Physician, Registered Nurse, Advanced Practice Nurse, or Other (if other, please specify). What is your medical specialty? Please choose from the following options: Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Surgery, Urology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Radiology, Anesthesia, Family Medicine, or Ophthalmology. For physicians, what is your current level of training? Please select one: Student, Intern, Resident, Fellow, or Attending. What is your age in years? What is your gender? Please select one: Male, Female, or Prefer not to disclose. Have you been diagnosed with any medical condition that may cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please answer Yes or No. Driving History What is your primary mode of transportation to and from work? Please select one: Drive (car or motorcycle), Public Transportation, Bicycle, Walk, or Other (if other, please specify). On average, how long does it take you to commute to and from work (one way)? How many years have you held a valid driver’s license? Please select one: Less than 5 years, 5-10 years, 11-15 years, 16-20 years, or More than 20 years. Have you ever been involved in a motor vehicle accident prior to entering the medical profession? How many motor vehicle accidents have you been involved in? How many of these accidents were caused by falling asleep at the wheel? How many of these accidents do you attribute to sleep deprivation? Motor Vehicle Accident History Have you ever felt drowsy or fatigued after completing a work shift? Please answer Yes or No. Have you ever fallen asleep while driving after a work shift? Please answer Yes or No. Have you ever experienced a near accident while driving after a work shift? Please answer Yes or No. Have you ever been involved in a motor vehicle accident while driving after a work shift? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in hospitalization? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in admission to an intensive care unit? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in life-threatening injuries? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in injuries to other individuals? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in another person visiting the emergency room? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in hospitalization for another person? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in another person being admitted to an intensive care unit? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in life-threatening injuries for another person? Please answer Yes or No. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in any chronic, permanent, or irreversible personal injury? Please answer Yes or No. Did you receive any government disability compensation as a result of this accident? If so, what was the estimated amount? If you do not know or do not wish to disclose, please indicate. Did the motor vehicle accident caused by sleep deprivation result in any chronic, permanent, or irreversible injury to others? Please answer Yes or No. Did any individuals involved in the accident receive government disability compensation as a result of the accident? If so, what was the estimated amount? If you do not know or do not wish to disclose, please indicate. Did the accident cause any psychological disturbances to you or your family members? Please answer Yes or No. If yes, please specify the type of psychological disturbance: Acute Stress Disorder, Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder, Anxiety, Depression, or Phobia.
